contracts.briefing: A bell with no rope is ringing beneath Skyhome. Kael holds the breach while your new guild follows Lantern Road to find a missing patrol, recover its Wayglass, and stop the threat gathering in the old Gatehouse.
contracts.failureConsequence: The patrol and Wayglass remain missing; the old Gatehouse route stays open toward Skyhome.
contracts.retreatConsequence: Any recovered patrol members return safely, but the Wayglass route remains unresolved.
contracts.tutorialFocus: Learn route choices, patrol events, Union battles, and the Wayglass mystery that opens Chapter 2.

contracts.briefing: The missing team left three route ledgers that disagree with one another. The newest marks are precise, recent, and unauthorized.
contracts.failureConsequence: The route remains unverified and future expeditions begin with less information.
contracts.retreatConsequence: Recovered evidence remains, but the missing crew may require a later rescue.
contracts.tutorialFocus: Learn fog, scouting, evidence, route information, and hidden enemy preparation.

contracts.briefing: The convoy carries medicine, tools, and food for the outer wards. It cannot survive another day of ambushes or a second failed route.
contracts.failureConsequence: The outer wards lose supplies and the Market/Warehouse project is delayed.
contracts.retreatConsequence: Any surviving wagons return, preserving part of the shipment.
contracts.tutorialFocus: Learn convoy protection, urgency, repeated threats, Guard, and supply management.

nodes.summary: Kael holds the sealed stair while Maren leads the new Unions toward the rope-less bell beneath Guild Hall.
Stand with Kael in Battle 1 of 3; break the first wave so Kiri can send Maren's Unions onto Lantern Road.
Jazzi can stabilize runner Una Queensrest; her blood-marked ledger points toward Zorin and the missing Wayglass.
Tazren reads Zorin's three lantern scuffs from the ridge and marks the safest line toward the waiting ambush.
Orren can anchor a line to pull scout Quin Lowen from the settling span and reopen Lantern Road.
Bessa finds Zorin's spare lantern oil and patrol cipher; take the rescue supplies without erasing the trail.
Maren and Daeven must break Battle 2 of 3 before the raiders close the only road to Zorin's patrol.
Maren calls one short rest: Jazzi tends wounds while the Unions settle how they will bring Zorin's patrol home.
Odelia hears the missing Wayglass twist the old Gatehouse chains; ground the blue pulse or carry its hazard forward.
Daeven spots an elite guarding Zorin's route slate; fight for the Gatehouse flank or take Gara's marked bypass.
Jazzi can stabilize Petra Runebrook while Zorin directs the lift; free her so all ten Lanterns move together.
Orren traces the Wayglass pulse to a broken Gatehouse service line; restore it for a safer Union approach.
Gara Redtail will carry the wounded Lanterns through the sealing passage; Zorin's route ledger stays exposed until the Gate-Eater falls.
Rally Zorin's ten Lanterns, secure the Wayglass, then defeat the Gate-Eater in Battle 3 of 3 before it reaches Skyhome.
Kiri waits at Guild Hall: bring Zorin's ten Lanterns and the recovered Wayglass home with every guildmate accounted for.
Rescue apprentice Sella Vey and test Orra Vale's brass line-tag against the Wayglass before choosing whose evidence the Guild will test first.
Use Sella's testimony: inspect the reversed fresh marks or cross Orra's failing survey bridge.

nodes.displayName: Fresh Marks on an Old Wall
nodes.summary: Compare the reversed paint to Orra's seven-notch brass tag and preserve proof of deliberate forgery.
Trace Orra's official survey steps through the false corridor and reveal the fog-stalker verge.
Stabilize Orra's five-pin bridge and document the empty socket that links it to the sabotage.
Recover the crew's brass survey pins and route cloth before the fog closes over the crossing.
Break the fog-stalker cordon in a certified Union battle before it can erase both surveyed routes.
Regroup, reduce fatigue, and give Sella room to name Orra and explain the erased seventh-return mark.

nodes.displayName: A Voice That Knows Their Names
nodes.summary: Challenge the fog's imitation of Orra with Sella's seven-notch evidence before following its hidden path.
Confront the elite directing the false marks for extra route evidence, or deliberately bypass it.
Rebuild Orra's shattered astrolabe and prove the Wayglass road continues beneath every city map.
Take the exposed line to recover Orra's crew count, door sketch, and sabotage notes before the rescue.
Gara Redtail can lower Sella and the wounded survey hands toward Orra's bell before the fog closes; Orra's exposed field book stays behind.
Rescue Orra Vale and the missing crew in a certified Union battle, then reach the unmapped door.
Return Sella, Orra, and their recovered route evidence to Skyhome's Wayglass table.
The Guild commits its deployment and supplies before entering the route.

events.title: Una's Blood-Marked Ledger
events.sceneText: Una Queensrest crawled away from Zorin's patrol with the Wayglass ledger, but blood loss is taking her voice.
events.exceptionalText: Una is stable, and her decoded ledger reveals Zorin's exact Gatehouse bearing plus the safer overlook.
events.fullSuccessText: Una is stable and gives Maren Zorin's exact bearing without costing the Unions momentum.
events.successWithCostText: Una and the ledger are safe, but the rescue costs supplies, fatigue, or precious road time.
events.setbackText: Una survives; a smeared bearing sends Maren along the harder trail, and the helpers remember the carry.
events.severeSetbackText: Una survives, but the unreadable ledger leaves Zorin's patrol farther ahead and the route more dangerous.
events.relationshipMemory: They carried Una Queensrest and her blood-marked ledger together.
events.cityConsequence: Una's testimony, Zorin's bearing, and Lantern Patrol trust

events.title: Quin at the Broken Waymarker
events.sceneText: Scout Quin Lowen hangs beneath a fractured waymarker while the lower Lantern Road span continues to settle.
events.exceptionalText: Quin is pulled clear, the lantern mechanism is restored, and Zorin's ambush warning becomes visible from the ridge.
events.fullSuccessText: Quin and the reopened waymarker are secure without costing Maren's Unions momentum.
events.successWithCostText: Quin is safe and Lantern Road reopens, but the lift costs supplies, fatigue, or precious road time.
events.setbackText: Quin survives; the damaged marker forces Maren onto the exposed approach, and the rescuers remember the line.
events.severeSetbackText: Quin survives, but the collapsed span leaves Zorin's warning unread and the road ahead more dangerous.
events.relationshipMemory: They held Quin Lowen's rescue line until every hand was back on Lantern Road.
events.cityConsequence: Quin's testimony, restored Lantern waymarker, and patrol rescue trust

events.title: Wayglass Resonance
events.sceneText: The missing Wayglass sends a blue pulse through old Gatehouse machinery and buckles the road ahead.
events.exceptionalText: The blue pulse is grounded and reveals the maintenance line leading straight to Zorin's trapped patrol.
events.fullSuccessText: The old chain settles, keeping Lantern Road open and the Gatehouse approach safe.
events.successWithCostText: The Wayglass pulse is contained, but burnt tools and strained hands cost supplies, fatigue, or road time.
events.setbackText: The surge passes; Odelia marks the unstable chain so Maren can carry the warning into the Gatehouse.
events.severeSetbackText: The chain holds, but its blue arcs leave Zorin's Gatehouse approach more dangerous for every Union.
events.relationshipMemory: They trusted Odelia's count and grounded the Wayglass pulse together.
events.cityConsequence: Odelia's Wayglass reading and the Gatehouse chain hazard

events.title: Petra Behind the Support
events.sceneText: Petra Runebrook is pinned beneath a cracked Gatehouse support, and Zorin refuses to leave without her.
events.exceptionalText: Petra is freed and shows Maren where Zorin gathered all ten Lanterns around the Wayglass.
events.fullSuccessText: Petra is stable, the cracked support is braced, and Zorin's patrol regroups without losing momentum.
events.successWithCostText: Petra rejoins Zorin, but the lift costs the rescuers supplies, fatigue, or precious road time.
events.setbackText: Petra survives; Zorin divides the carry, slowing the patrol while preserving their promise to leave together.
events.severeSetbackText: Petra survives, but the failing support pins the patrol on the Gate-Eater's exposed approach.
events.relationshipMemory: They answered Zorin's count and lifted Petra Runebrook together.
events.cityConsequence: Petra's rescue, Zorin's full patrol count, and Wayglass readiness

events.title: Orren's Blue Service Line
events.sceneText: Orren sees the Wayglass pulse reveal a broken Gatehouse service line for only a few seconds.
events.exceptionalText: Orren restores the service line, giving Maren's Unions a protected Gatehouse flank and a gateglass sample.
events.fullSuccessText: The blue maintenance marks hold long enough to secure a clean approach to Zorin and the Gate-Eater.
events.successWithCostText: The service route opens, but the rushed repair costs tools, fatigue, or precious road time.
events.setbackText: The blue light fades; Orren preserves enough marks to guide Gara through a narrower approach.
events.severeSetbackText: The service line collapses, leaving Zorin safe but forcing every Union onto the Gate-Eater's exposed road.
events.relationshipMemory: They followed Orren's blue marks until the hidden service line held.
events.cityConsequence: Restored Gatehouse service line and recovered gateglass sample

events.title: Gara's Wounded-Lantern Passage
events.sceneText: Gara Redtail has one turn of the maintenance wheel before the old passage seals. Two wounded Lanterns need both carriers, while Zorin's route ledger lies across the exposed road. She asks the Guildmaster to choose who holds the passage and who carries the wounded; the people can come through now, but the ledger may have to wait until the Gate-Eater falls.
events.exceptionalText: Gara holds the wheel while the paired carriers bring both wounded Lanterns through. One of them saves a torn page bearing Zorin's Gatehouse count before the passage seals.
events.fullSuccessText: Both wounded Lanterns reach Gara's side of the passage, and she seals the exposed road behind them. Zorin's complete route ledger remains outside until the Gate-Eater is defeated.
events.successWithCostText: Gara gets both wounded Lanterns through, but the closing stone takes the stretcher frame and leaves Zorin's route ledger on the exposed road.
events.setbackText: The first carry stalls in the narrow turn. Gara spends the last shield brace to free it, brings both Lanterns through, and seals the passage without the route ledger.
events.severeSetbackText: The maintenance wheel breaks after the final wounded Lantern crosses. Gara bars the passage by hand; everyone lives, but the Gatehouse approach loses both the ledger and its safest retreat.
events.relationshipMemory: They answered Gara Redtail's call and carried every wounded Lantern through before the old passage sealed.
events.cityConsequence: Gara Redtail's wounded Lanterns, the sealed maintenance passage, and Zorin's route ledger left for later

events.title: The Seventh Name at Camp
events.sceneText: At the quiet camp, apprentice Sella Vey finally names Master Surveyor Orra Vale and admits she scrubbed Orra's seventh-return mark after the fog spoke in Orra's voice.
events.exceptionalText: Sella draws Orra's complete seventh-return sign from memory. The Guild records the missing final stroke, calms both Unions, and carries a reliable warning toward the astrolabe.
events.fullSuccessText: Sella names Orra and explains why she erased the last stroke; both Unions accept the warning and leave camp together.
events.successWithCostText: Sella shares Orra's name and warning, but the careful conversation costs route pressure before the Union can move.
events.setbackText: The argument closes around Sella before she can finish. The Guild preserves camp cohesion, but carries only a partial warning and a recoverable relationship memory.
events.severeSetbackText: Sella retreats from the argument. The Guild marks her testimony unresolved and continues without losing a member, accepting extra fatigue and uncertainty.
events.relationshipMemory: At the quiet camp, they gave Sella Vey room to name Orra Vale and the erased seventh-return mark.
events.cityConsequence: Sella's trust, the seventh-return warning, and recoverable relationship memory

events.title: Fresh Marks on an Old Wall
events.sceneText: Fresh paint reverses the official return stroke. Sella Vey's brass line-tag bears Orra Vale's real seven-notch route code, giving the Union evidence it can test before choosing the corridor.
events.exceptionalText: The actor proves the paint was laid from inside the wall and finds Orra's hidden countermark. The forgery, its maker's direction, and the safe scouting line all enter the Guild record.
events.fullSuccessText: The Union matches the brass tag to Orra's real stroke, rejects the false corridor, and marks the safer scouting line.
events.successWithCostText: The forgery is proved, but testing every mark spends supplies and lets the fog thicken along the safe branch.
events.setbackText: The Union identifies the reversed stroke only after exposing itself to the corridor. The route remains open, but the ambush keeps its advantage.
events.severeSetbackText: The paint code stays uncertain. The Guild records the brass tag as unresolved evidence and advances without deleting either route or any recruit.
events.relationshipMemory: They trusted Sella Vey's brass line-tag when the wall tried to give them an easier answer.
events.cityConsequence: Forged-mark evidence, ambush warning, and safe scouting branch

events.title: A Bridge Measured Twice
events.sceneText: Orra Vale's load ledger calls for five brass survey pins, but the failing bridge carries only four. The missing pin links the crossing to the altered route marks.
events.exceptionalText: The Union braces the bridge with the ledger's original geometry and recovers tool scratches from the removed fifth pin, preserving supplies and proving deliberate sabotage.
events.fullSuccessText: The bridge is stabilized, the Union crosses together, and the empty fifth socket is recorded as evidence.
events.successWithCostText: The crossing holds, but a brace and rope bundle are left behind; the missing-pin evidence survives at a supply cost.
events.setbackText: The first brace slips and adds fatigue. A second crossing remains legal, and the empty fifth socket still points toward sabotage.
events.severeSetbackText: The bridge cannot carry the full formation. The Guild spends supplies on a recoverable detour, keeps every member, and retains the ledger evidence.
events.relationshipMemory: They held Orra Vale's measured line together while the sabotaged bridge tried to separate them.
events.cityConsequence: Bridge access, missing-pin evidence, and supplies

events.title: A Voice That Knows Their Names
events.sceneText: The fog calls in Orra Vale's voice and names every missing surveyor, but it orders six returns. Sella Vey's brass line-tag carries seven, exposing the voice as an imitation.
events.exceptionalText: The Union answers with the seventh-return phrase. The false voice recoils and reveals both its hidden path and the Route Mutilator directing it.
events.fullSuccessText: The Union holds to the seven-notch evidence, breaks the imitation's rhythm, and follows its retreat toward the hidden path.
events.successWithCostText: The voice is exposed, but answering it raises threat and leaves one recruit carrying the memory of Orra's stolen cadence.
events.setbackText: The fog separates the formation long enough to add fatigue. Sella's seven-notch evidence brings everyone back to the legal route.
events.severeSetbackText: The imitation keeps its hidden path. The Guild withdraws to the last true mark, records the threat, and preserves a route forward without losing a member.
events.relationshipMemory: They repeated Sella Vey's seventh-return phrase until Orra Vale's stolen voice could no longer divide them.
events.cityConsequence: Impostor evidence, threat, hidden path, and relationship memory

events.title: The Needle Points Below
events.sceneText: Orra Vale's shattered astrolabe ignores the visible road and follows a warm Wayglass pulse beneath it. A penciled seventh notch points toward the unmapped door inside Skyhome.
events.exceptionalText: The actor rebuilds the needle cradle and plots the pulse, the Route Mutilator, and Orra's field-book cache on one map. The optional recovery line opens with full evidence.
events.fullSuccessText: The astrolabe confirms a moving pulse below the road and marks the descent to Orra's field book.
events.successWithCostText: The below-road pulse is fixed on the map, but stabilizing the cracked lens costs supplies before the optional recovery.
events.setbackText: The needle gives only a narrow bearing. The Union may still choose Orra's field book or the safe descent, but without elite intelligence.
events.severeSetbackText: The lens fails after proving only that the road continues below. Both onward routes remain legal, and the Guild records the broken instrument for later study.
events.relationshipMemory: They believed Orra Vale's penciled seventh notch when the astrolabe pointed beneath every known map.
events.cityConsequence: Door-inside evidence, elite intelligence, and secondary-objective route

events.title: Orra's Pack Beneath the Line
events.sceneText: Orra Vale's pack is lashed below the safe descent with her field book inside. Sella Vey recognizes the knot, while fog stalkers watch the recovery line.
events.exceptionalText: The Union recovers Orra's field book without alerting the watchers and finds the missing crew's headcount, door sketch, and sabotage notes intact.
events.fullSuccessText: Orra's field book comes free with the rescue route and seventh-return evidence readable.
events.successWithCostText: The field book is recovered, but the watchers force a hurried climb that spends supplies or fatigue before the rescue.
events.setbackText: Several pages tear during the recovery. The headcount survives, the objective counts, and the Guild advances with incomplete door evidence.
events.severeSetbackText: The pack cannot be safely cut loose. The Guild marks its exact position for a later civic recovery and continues toward the trapped surveyors.
events.relationshipMemory: They took the exposed line together so Sella Vey would not have to leave Orra Vale's field book behind.
events.cityConsequence: Orra's field book, surveyor rescue advantage, and Civic Trust

events.title: Gara Holds the Lantern Descent
events.sceneText: Sella Vey hears Orra Vale's survey bell below just as Gara Redtail finds the last working lift cradle. The wounded survey hands cannot descend alone. The Guildmaster must choose whether Gara lowers Sella beside them or anchors the cradle while a Union escorts them; either order reaches Orra sooner, but her exposed field book stays behind.
events.exceptionalText: Gara lowers Sella and every wounded survey hand together. Sella hears Orra answer the bell, while Gara cuts a brass countermark from the cradle before the fog closes over the abandoned field book.
events.fullSuccessText: Sella and the wounded survey hands reach Orra's bell below. Gara keeps the cradle steady until the last boots touch stone, then leaves the exposed field book marked for recovery.
events.successWithCostText: The wounded survey hands reach the lower ledge with Sella, but Gara must abandon the lift cradle and Orra's field book to keep the fog from following them down.
events.setbackText: The cradle jams halfway. Gara and the escort lower each wounded surveyor by hand, preserving every life while Orra's field book remains above with the watchers.
events.severeSetbackText: The cradle tears free after Sella reaches the lower ledge. Gara holds the line until every wounded surveyor is down, but the Guild loses the easy return and must face Orra's rescue from below.
events.relationshipMemory: They trusted Gara Redtail to hold the last descent while Sella Vey guided every wounded survey hand toward Orra Vale's bell.
events.cityConsequence: Gara's protected descent, Sella and the wounded survey hands, and Orra's field book left for later

events.title: Sella Vey at the Threshold
events.sceneText: Apprentice surveyor Sella Vey crouches behind the Wayglass threshold with Master Surveyor Orra Vale's brass line-tag. She says the missing crew followed fresh marks that reverse Orra's seventh-return stroke.
events.exceptionalText: Sella places Orra's brass line-tag against the Wayglass. Its seventh notch glows, the forgery is identified before departure, and both routes open with reliable testimony.
events.fullSuccessText: Sella trusts the Guild with Orra's line-tag and demonstrates the false marks' reversed stroke. The threshold opens with usable evidence.
events.successWithCostText: Sella speaks after the Union steadies her, but the delay costs route pressure. The brass tag still proves the official crew crossed the threshold.
events.setbackText: Sella cannot face the painted corridor. The Guild spends supplies securing her at the threshold and continues with the brass line-tag as partial evidence.
events.severeSetbackText: Sella shuts down when pressed. The Guild assigns a safe escort, records her testimony as unresolved, and keeps both routes open without losing her or a recruit.
events.relationshipMemory: They gave Sella Vey time to place Orra Vale's brass line-tag in their hands.
events.cityConsequence: Sella's rescue, the brass line-tag testimony, and Civic Trust

tutorialBeats.title: The Ruined Annex Lives
tutorialBeats.instruction: Inspect the Hall, priority notices, and parallel member assignments.
tutorialBeats.completion: Open Hall and inspect one member assignment.

tutorialBeats.title: People Before Numbers
tutorialBeats.instruction: Open the committed Applicant Board and inspect one dossier.
tutorialBeats.completion: Open one dossier and sign one recruit.

tutorialBeats.title: Equipment Shapes Arts
tutorialBeats.instruction: Manually equip the new recruit and inspect legal weapon Arts.

tutorialBeats.title: Build Two Unions
tutorialBeats.instruction: Assign the recruit and verify formation legality.

tutorialBeats.title: Found the Settlement
tutorialBeats.instruction: Place the first charter building and assign staff.
tutorialBeats.completion: One building and one staff assignment persist.

tutorialBeats.title: Choose a Responsibility
tutorialBeats.instruction: Compare three authored contracts and commit one.
tutorialBeats.completion: One contract and board seed are committed.

tutorialBeats.title: Every Route Has a Cost
tutorialBeats.instruction: Choose a branch, resolve an event/check, and reach camp.
tutorialBeats.completion: Committed move, check, and camp state exist.

tutorialBeats.title: The Encounter Pays Off
tutorialBeats.instruction: Enter the certified Union battle from the committed node.
tutorialBeats.completion: Battle return receipt applies exactly once.

tutorialBeats.title: Growth Builds the City
tutorialBeats.instruction: Claim equipment, review all XP channels, and continue city construction.
tutorialBeats.completion: Reward claimed, manually equipped, and city progress applied.

tutorialBeats.title: A Permanent Guild
tutorialBeats.instruction: Save, close, relaunch, and verify recruit, city, board, relationships, and equipment.
